'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Roy Bordier LS Hidden Base (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Roy Bordier]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base (V) / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (V)|VB4-L-hiddenbase-pre.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Ray Bordier
* '''Deck name:''' Bothans 2.643
* '''Username:''' Spectre
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
